scenes.text: Imagine holding a beautiful piece of glass so incredibly strong that it can easily shatter a copper-jacketed bullet fired directly at it.
This is called a Prince Rupert's drop, created by dripping molten glass into cold water, which instantly freezes the outside while the inside remains under extreme, trapped tension.
You can smash the bulbous head with a heavy steel hammer and it will not even scratch, making it seem completely indestructible to any normal force.

However, if you apply the slightest pinch to its delicate, curly tail, a massive shockwave tears through the glass at three thousand miles per hour, exploding it into fine powder; would you dare to hold one of these in your bare hand, so tell me in the comments and follow for more science!
